draft.shortGloss: to be free; to have free time
draft.emotion: relaxed and inviting, ready to make plans with a friend
notes: A separable verb-object phrase; its negative form is 没空 (méikòng, to be busy).
Here 空 is pronounced in the fourth tone (kòng, free time), not the first tone (kōng, empty). Often pronounced 有空儿 (yǒukòngr) in northern speech.

senses.definition: To have spare time; to be free or available.
